ammonia.reason: Low secondary deamination in pressed low-moisture interior; ammonia not quantified in Manchego.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole not found; slight sheep pasture phenols but clean brine-pressed make.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic rennet peptides from sheep casein at low pH 4.85, tempered by salt and fat.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; background 2-heptanone 512 mg/kg from fatty-acid beta-oxidation gives faint ketone must.

browning.reason: Residual peptides, amino acids and lactate undergo Maillard on heating to golden-brown.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus citrate metabolism yields diacetyl 1145 mg/kg plus acetoin 249 mg/kg in high-fat sheep matrix.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate lipolysis: butyric 17.3 mg/kg plus caproic 4.0 mg/kg plus acetic 133 mg/kg from lipase/esterase.

creaminess.reason: Fat 32.5% ~52% FDM sheep butterfat coats mouth despite firm pressed paste.

crumbliness.reason: Moisture 37.2% plus 3-4 mo proteolysis and calcium-lactate crystals cause granular fracture.

firmness.reason: Washed-curd pressed 20h to moisture 37.2% forms dense demineralized paracasein network.

floral_honey.reason: Phe catabolism yields phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol rose/floral in <1000 Da WSF fractions.

fruity.reason: High ethanol 4385 mg/kg drives esterification to even-chain ethyl butyrate to decanoate, low vs surface cheeses.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk short and branched-chain fatty acids including caproic and methyloctanoic-type; calf rennet not goat-pregastric.

malty_nutty.reason: Very high Strecker 3-methylbutanal 1359 mg/kg from leucine catabolism gives malty-hazelnut note.

melt.reason: pH 4.85 demineralized casein at 37% moisture flows moderately on heating but not fluid.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected; no mold linoleate oxidation.

oil_off.reason: High 32.5% sheep butterfat coalesces and leaks free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked paste; guaiacol not detected and smoked false.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic fermentation to pH 4.85 plus acetic 133 mg/kg and propionic 35 mg/kg from heterofermentative LAB.

stretch.reason: Rennet-pressed non-pasta-filata curd lacks aligned plasticized casein; stretched false.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Light heating only to 37-38C without whey-protein denaturation; methanethiol/DMDS not detected.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted but diacetyl/acetoin and propionic acid give faint sweet-caramel against acid.

umami.reason: 3-4 mo rennet plus LAB proteolysis of 25% protein releases glutamate savory peptides.
